newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Southern Air closes aircraft financing.
newsitem.headline: China Southern Air closes aircraft financing.

text.p: China Southern Airlines Co has closed a US$145.67 million export financing for the purchase of a Boeing 777-200Bs commercial aircraft, Bank of America said on Tuesday.

Bank of America and Bank of China are joint arrangers, with Bank of America acting as the sole underwriter of the 12-year US$85.82 million term loan guaranteed by the Export-Import Bank of the United States.
Bank of China, acting through its New York and London branches, is the sole underwriter of the remaining commercial portion in the amount of US$59.85 million for 10 years.
The aircraft will be delivered on February 28.
Guangzhou-based China Southern Airlines is one of the three largest state-owned airlines in China. It owns and operates a fleet of 90 aircraft, two-thirds of them Boeings.
